title: Affine-local quasi-coherence of higher direct images
statement: For a quasi-compact separated morphism and quasi-coherent module, every affine open U of the base has quasi-coherent restriction of the q-th higher direct image.

proof.text: Apply the two localization assertions: every section on a principal open lifts after multiplying by a power, and every section restricting to zero is annihilated by a power. The existing isQuasicoherent_of_forall_isAffineOpen criterion therefore proves quasi-coherence on T. Apply SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent_over to each affine open U.

proof_origin.place: Part (1), using the localization criterion; the two localization assertions are reduced to Tags 09MR and 01E4.
